TDD-first does not fit: a behavior test would not change outcome before vs after — the validators don't change, and the existing `validation.test.ts` / `validation-scanner.test.ts` / `validation-alt-required.test.ts` suites are themselves the behavior contract this refactor must preserve. A structural file-content test pinning "no inline `memoryStorage` definitions in these files" would be proof-of-work that rule 41 says to prune; a developer would not naturally re-add an inline impl when the shared helper is established. Recommended maintainer action: apply by hand (or via fix-bot routed as `bug + ready-for-agent` per team-preferences rule 40 — SOLID/DRY violations are "bugs" in the rule-contract sense). Order per the candidate's `suggested_action`: `validation.test.ts` first (smallest blast radius, also clears the `as StorageProvider` cast), then `validation-scanner.test.ts` + `validation-alt-required.test.ts`. The change is bounded (~100 LOC removed, three 9-line wrappers added) and the existing test suites' green status is the regression proof.

Recommended maintainer action: open a short grilling Q on `design-logging.md` (a / b / "scope to server + add a 'browser-tier guidance' paragraph deferring to OfflineBanner + future toast surface"), lock the answer in the design doc, then either spec the client logger as its own designed feature or land the 20-30 line docs clarification (and reconcile the now-partially-obsolete `main.ts:77-83` TODO against shipped Cut 12).

The candidate is legitimate — `github-prior-comment.test.ts` (150 LOC) is a genuine duplicate of the `hasPriorBotComment` + `hasPriorCommentFromBot` coverage already in `github-comment-queries.test.ts`. Two unique cases would need lifting first (empty-comments-array; end-of-body outcome-tag positioning that pins `.includes()` vs `.startsWith()` semantic). However, the coverage-shape recipe is scoped to filling coverage gaps against untested working code with per-test counterfactual discipline — its "single commit, tests pass on first run" contract doesn't map onto a lift-then-delete hygiene task, and its "Not for" clause explicitly excludes test-quality-rewrite work. The `tdd-first` recipe doesn't fit either (no defect to test-drive). Maintainer action: route as a fix-bot candidate per team-preferences rule 40 (task shape: one-shot hygiene / DRY violation with `bug + ready-for-agent`), OR split into two review-bot-ready cuts — (a) a legitimate `coverage-shape` cut adding the 2 unique cases (empty-comments-array; end-of-body tag positioning) to `github-comment-queries.test.ts` with counterfactuals, followed by (b) a maintainer-driven or fix-bot deletion of `github-prior-comment.test.ts`. Recommend the split so the coverage-shape recipe can handle the additive portion cleanly and the deletion goes through a shape better suited to file-level hygiene.
